plain_english: On the middle tongue, in the opened mouth, in the middle — awareness cast: the h-uttering made by mind, then in calm it dissolves.
sanskrit_cite: madhyajihve sphāritāsye madhye nikṣipya cetanām | hoccāraṃ manasā kurvaṃs tataḥ śānte pralīyate

plain_english: On seat, on bed, having stood — unsupported, envisioning one's own body in mind: when mind wasted — in a moment, wasted-impurity may be.
sanskrit_cite: āsane śayane sthitvā nirādhāraṃ vibhāvayan | svadehaṃ manasi kṣiṇe kṣaṇāt kṣīṇāśayo bhavet

plain_english: On a moving seat, standing now — slowly, or by the body's moving: in the calmed mind, in that state, O Goddess, the divine flood may be won.
sanskrit_cite: calāsane sthitasyātha śanair vā dehacālanāt | praśānte mānase bhāve devi divyaugham āpnuyāt

plain_english: Sky, stainless, seeing — gaze made unbroken: stunned self at that moment, O Goddess, the Bhairava form may be won.
sanskrit_cite: ākāśaṃ vimalam paśyan kṛtvā dṛṣṭiṃ nirantarām | stabdhātmā tatkṣaṇād devi bhairavaṃ vapur āpnuyāt

plain_english: Dissolved on the crown, sky all as Bhairava should be contemplated: that all — the Bhairava-form-blaze-reality may enter.
sanskrit_cite: līnaṃ mūrdhni viyat sarvam bhairavatvena bhāvayet | tat sarvam bhairavākāratejastattvaṃ samāviśet

plain_english: Something known — duality-giving, outer light, darkness again: the universe-form of Bhairava — having known, endless-light-bearing.
sanskrit_cite: kiñcij jñātaṃ dvaitadāyi bāhyālokas tamaḥ punaḥ | viśvādi bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ jñātvānantaprakāśabhṛt

plain_english: Thus indeed in bad night, on the dark fortnight's arrival, long: contemplating timira — Bhairava's form will come to.
sanskrit_cite: evam eva durniśāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣāgame ciram | taimiram bhāvayan rūpam bhairavaṃ rūpam eṣyati

plain_english: Thus indeed, having closed first the eyes, black lustre before: spread Bhairava's form, contemplating — made of that he may be.
sanskrit_cite: evam eva nimīlyādau netre kṛṣṇābham agrataḥ | prasārya bhairavaṃ rūpam bhāvayaṃs tanmayo bhavet

plain_english: Of whichever organ even — from its striking and its blocking: of one entered in the nondual, in void — there itself the self shines forth.
sanskrit_cite: yasya kasyendriyasyāpi vyāghātāc ca nirodhataḥ | praviṣṭasyādvaye śūnye tatraivātmā prakāśate

plain_english: No drop, no emission, and the a-syllable of muttering great: rises, O Goddess, suddenly — knowledge-flood, the highest Lord.
sanskrit_cite: abindum avisargaṃ ca akāraṃ japato mahān | udeti devi sahasā jñānaughaḥ parameśvaraḥ
